answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region during peak settlement writes. Rollback is unavailable (mandated security patch), so memory_b1 is inapplicable. Circuit breaking would fail customer writes and violates the objective. Read-replica routing historically offloaded report/read traffic, which is not the fault described. Capacity headroom helped when provisioned before a peak, but we are already in the peak and the stall is region-scoped, so adding boxes in the degraded region is a weaker match. Regional failover is the closest analog: prior primary-region latency degradation recovered in minutes with a clean traffic shift, keeping writes flowing. Verifying b2 and b3 for archive caveats. Residual uncertainty: whether the new build is primary-only, and failover risk to in-flight settlement writes.
